Python loops

Python loops execute instructions repeatedly. Use for loops to iterate over elements in a collection and process each element. The loop body runs once for each value.

Loop example

for value in values:
    print(value)
    total += value

Each value is printed and added to the total. The indented statements form the body of the loop. Indentation matters because it determines which instructions are repeated.

LoopMeaning
forIterate over values
whileRepeat while true
